root: ^CG: SILHOUETTE OF THE OLD GRANITE QUARRY, KAMPONG ROOFS BELOW, HILLS UNTOUCHED BY HIGH-RISES
^MC AND UNCLE PAUSE TO CATCH THEIR BREATH. THEY SIT ON A ROCK, LOOKING OUT
^He always come up here when we fight. He says the clouds don't argue back.
^My father brought me up this same hill when I was his age.
^(Why is this uncle reminiscing about his past right now..! I need to get out of this situation to get back home…)
^"These deep recurrences. These shifting runes. That touched my father, now my son."
^No lah. Just something that I read before. It stays in the head. It’s useful, sometimes, when you don't have your own words.
^My father started the shophouse. Kopi and noodles. I was born practically behind that counter.
^Yeah yeah. It's been a long time. Long enough I forget what my hands smell like without coffee grounds.
^HE LAUGHS AT HIS OWN JOKE, THEN STOPS. FIDDLES WITH HIS SLEEVE INSTEAD OF LOOKING AT HER
^My son told me last week he don't want it. He doesn't want to continue to shop.
^Tsk, you're probably the same age as him. You should give some advice to an uncle like me.
^I just met you an hour ago, uncle. I don't think I'm qualified.
^He says he wants computer. He wants office. He say, 'Pa, the whole world changing, why do you want me to wipe tables and pour coffee forever?'
